title: Use with a device I already have

why.heading: Link this device to one you already use
why.footer: Your other device scans the QR code this shows and vouches for this device's key. This device then sees your Machines, Agents and Tasks, and can command them the same way.

hub.label: Hub
hub.footer: The same Hub your other device uses

name.label: Name of this device
name.footer: Your other device can change it before approving.

qr.heading: On your other device, go to Workspace, then My devices, tap Link new device and scan this
qr.label: QR code to link this device
qr.link: Or copy this link and paste it on your other device

waiting: Waiting for your other device to approve…
secret: This QR code and link hold a secret. Don't send them to anyone or keep a photo of them.
